finding: Independent review of all 105 new tree and hill rows found a final set of technically valid but semantically misleading nearby-city assignments and raw bboxes that were too tight. This plan gives those objectives honest browse-page labels and makes raw-bbox containment, rather than the model's typo-tolerance margin, part of the admission gate.
